title: Reword every phrase on HQ's pages that only makes sense inside this studio
ask: Daniel, 2026-09-04: "We need a way to eradicate all of this hard to handle text. It's only causing friction, and the friction is so severe that it's getting in way of the process." tools/check_writing.py now finds these automatically and CI fails on them. About 50 are in the front-end string literals you own.
first_action: Run `python3 tools/check_writing.py` and fix every MUST FIX it reports under hq/static/*.js. Each finding names the word, what it actually means, and the plain wording to reach for. Rewrite the sentence rather than swapping the word — 'the proof is fresh enough to believe' wants to become something like 'the tests were run recently enough to trust'. Where a word genuinely has to stay, put `plain-ok: <reason>` on the line, which the check reports rather than hides. Do not touch code comments: rationale belongs there and is written for whoever maintains the file. Re-run the check until only soft
